dct_description_sm: The GRID3 COD - Health Zones v9.0 dataset consists of health zone boundaries with name and other related attributes for all the twenty-six provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD). The current version supersedes the GRID3 COD - Health Zones v8.0 . The following changes were made: - The data for Haut-Katanga, Haut-Lomami, Ituri, Kwango, Lomami, Maniema, and Tanganyika provinces were updated - Health zone names were updated. Dataset citation: Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2026. GRID3 COD - Health Zones v9.0. New York: Columbia University. https://data.humdata.org/dataset/grid3-cod-health-zones-v9-0. Accessed [DAY MONTH YEAR]. Contacts and data queries: The authors of this dataset appreciate feedback regarding the data, including suggestions, discovery of errors, difficulties in using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please send an email to: info@ciesin.columbia.edu
